call.openAndResolve: Open the call and resolve the conflict
call.openAndResolve.novoice: Open the chat and resolve the conflict
call.explainsConflict: The call explains the conflict; the resolution happens on its own screen, in a local worktree. Nothing goes to GitLab without your "yes" to the push.
call.explainsConflict.novoice: The chat explains the conflict; the resolution happens on its own screen, in a local worktree. Nothing goes to GitLab without your "yes" to the push.
call.opening: Good morning. There are {total} activities, {blocked} blocked. I start with the blocked ones. To answer, press space, speak and press it again.
call.opening.novoice: Good morning. There are {total} activities, {blocked} blocked. I start with the blocked ones. To answer, type in the box below or tap a suggestion.
call.effectsNote: Nothing here runs in the call. Each item goes to Claude Code and waits for your "yes".
call.effectsNote.novoice: Nothing here runs in the chat. Each item goes to Claude Code and waits for your "yes".
settings.notifications.hint: Pre-daily time, new blockers (with an invitation to the call) and status changes.
settings.notifications.hint.novoice: Pre-daily time, new blockers (with an invitation to the chat) and status changes.
settings.appearance.hint: Applies when saved. The call and the dark panels stay dark in both themes.
settings.appearance.hint.novoice: Applies when saved. The chat and the dark panels stay dark in both themes.
notify.preDaily.body: The agents are ready for the call. Click to join.
notify.preDaily.body.novoice: The agents are ready for the chat. Click to join.
help.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts and voice
help.shortcuts.intro: They work on the screens with a microphone: call, unblock, gate, QA handoff, QA return, conflict and retro.
help.shortcuts.intro.novoice: Every screen works by text while voice is off: pre-daily, unblock, gate, QA handoff, QA return, conflict and retro.
help.type.text: The conversation screens have a text field ("Or type…") to write instead of speaking: type and press {key}.
help.type.text.novoice: The conversation screens have a text field to write the answer or the question: type and press {key}.
help.voice.off.text: Off: nothing is spoken or recorded, and the app does not start the voice engine. To turn it on, go to Settings › Voice.
help.voice.off.text.novoice: Off: nothing is spoken or recorded, and the app does not start the voice engine. To turn it on, go to Settings › Voice.
help.commands.title: Voice commands in the call
help.commands.intro: In the pre-daily, the app reads what you say (no accents, lower case) before sending it to the agent. Any other sentence goes to the activity agent.
help.commands.intro.novoice: In the pre-daily, the app reads what you type (no accents, lower case) before sending it to the agent. Any other sentence goes to the activity agent.
help.cmd.end: Ends the call and shows the end of the agenda, from where you generate the minutes. Anywhere in the sentence.
help.cmd.end.novoice: Ends the chat and shows the end of the agenda, from where you generate the minutes. Anywhere in the sentence.
help.preDaily: Reads GitLab through daily-report and builds one agent per activity, blocked ones first. In the call, the moderator opens and each agent speaks in turn (about 30 seconds): what moved, the next step, the blocker and, if any, a question for you. Your answers become decisions and effects, which go to the minutes.
help.preDaily.novoice: Reads GitLab through daily-report and builds one agent per activity, blocked ones first. In the chat, the moderator opens and each agent writes in turn (a few lines): what moved, the next step, the blocker and, if any, a question for you. Your answers become decisions and effects, which go to the minutes.
help.effects.term: Run the effects of the call
help.effects.term.novoice: Run the effects of the chat
help.theme: Settings › Appearance: system, light or dark. The call and the highlight panels stay dark in both.
help.theme.novoice: Settings › Appearance: system, light or dark. The chat and the highlight panels stay dark in both.
err.conflictOpenCall: the conflict is resolved on its own screen: open the call
err.conflictOpenCall.novoice: the conflict is resolved on its own screen: open the chat
